h1: EncuentraYa: Building a Production-Ready Search Platform from the Ground Up
intro: EncuentraYa needed a solid technical foundation to bring their marketplace vision to life. Urruty Labs stepped in to deliver senior engineering leadership, a scalable architecture, and a production-ready product — fast. Read all

overview.engagementValue: Platform architecture, MVP development, and technical leadership
overview.outcomeValue: A scalable, production-ready marketplace platform launched and ready for user traction
overview.p1: EncuentraYa is an early-stage startup building a search and discovery marketplace for the Uruguayan market. With a clear product vision and validated demand, the founding team needed a trusted technical partner to translate their idea into a working, scalable product.
overview.p2: Urruty Labs was brought in to provide senior engineering leadership from day one — making architecture decisions, setting up the development environment, and delivering a production-ready MVP within 90 days.

challenge.p1: EncuentraYa's founders had strong domain expertise and a compelling product concept, but lacked the in-house technical capacity to build and ship a production-grade platform. They needed more than just code — they needed senior judgment on technology choices, infrastructure, and long-term scalability.
items: Defining a scalable architecture that could support rapid iteration without accumulating technical debt
Building a search and discovery experience that felt fast and intuitive for end users
Establishing engineering practices and tooling that would support future team growth
Delivering a production-ready product on an aggressive 90-day timeline

solution.p1: Urruty Labs embedded as the senior technical lead for the engagement, owning architecture decisions end-to-end and working closely with the founding team to align technical execution with business priorities.
solution.p2: Key elements of the engagement included:
items: Designed a modular, cloud-native architecture optimized for search performance and future extensibility
Built the core platform features — search, listing management, and user flows — with production-quality code
Implemented CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure-as-code to enable reliable, repeatable deployments
Established coding standards, documentation practices, and a technical roadmap to support the next phase of growth
solution.p3: Throughout the engagement, every decision was made with scale in mind — ensuring that the foundation built in 90 days could support the product for years to come.

results.p1: At the end of the engagement, EncuentraYa had a fully functional, production-ready platform live at
items: Production-ready MVP delivered within the 90-day timeline
Scalable architecture in place to support user growth and feature expansion
Clean, maintainable codebase with documentation and engineering standards established
Founding team equipped with the technical foundation and roadmap to continue building confidently

contact.p: Whether you're starting from scratch or need to strengthen an existing product, Urruty Labs brings senior engineering leadership to help you build right — and build fast.
